_tile: Olive Trees with the Alpilles in the Background, added after M9 on the author's word as the door into a world of its own. The Museum of Modern Art publishes no scan of its own; this is the Google Art Project reproduction on Commons at 4043 x 3211, which is 44 px/cm -- below the 120 the extractor was tuned at, and about the Church at Auvers's 46, so the strokes come out of an upsampled image and the finest of them are lost. Rectangles by tools/tiles.py: paint is the writhing ground under the middle trees, thin the sky at the top right; paint carries 4.6x thin's energy.
